items.item_text: Are you interested in joining a dynamic, fast-paced environment? The incumbent will perform duties as an Operating Room Assistant to include: patient moving and transport, blood products, specimens, and equipment transport; equipment maintenance, room readiness, restocking supplies, cleaning soiled rooms/supplies, storing and distributing anesthesia support materials. Other duties include but are not limited to customer service and departmental efficiencies. The OR Assistant is under the direct supervision of the Clinical Support Manager and Supervisors. Assignments are given according to organizational goals.
Awareness of potential exposure to injury of hazardous materials

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Ability to meet the physical requirements of the job: Ability to lift, carry, push or pull 50lbs. or more, constant (80-90% of the time)
Communication skills to take direction or instructions
Ability to articulate with a diverse and multidisciplinary team
Knowledge of disinfectants germicide and sterilant
Knowledge of infection control, AORN, and AAMI standards related to job functions
Knowledge of government regulations: JCAHO, OSHA, Waste Management
